notes.title: May 1st 2020 Bug Fix
notes.notes:
A new patch has just been released today.

It addresses a crash that occurred while falling down in the city after level 2 (the museum).

We had to merge the patch file with the game's files to fix the problem. We apologize for the bigger download it occurs. No saved data will be affected by the new update and you will be able to progress safely!

Thank you!

notes.title: New Content Update
notes.notes:
With the release of The Inner Friend on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, we also have added a new and unlockable cutscene in all three versions of the game!

To unlock the new cutscene, collect all 27 hidden objects throughout the game. Once you have all the objects, go to the bedroom, and take a look at the television.

Players who already have collected all objects are invited to simply go to the bedroom and interact with the TV!

Enjoy!
